rationale: Selected the rank-one anti-loop edit in layer 23 MLP down_proj. Diagnosis: base generations overwhelmingly failed by repetitive/unfinished thinking (e.g. repeated Wait/checking loops) rather than lack of arithmetic; base probe showed high next-token probability for Wait on actual loop motifs. The edit uses a loop-context activation detector from layer-23 MLP inputs and shifts only those contexts away from Wait-like continuations toward ordinary continuation/closure tokens; embeddings/head/final norm were not edited. Causal probe confirmed Wait was removed from top predictions on loop motifs while normal solution contexts changed minimally. Strength comparison on the original 32 favored alpha=8 over alpha=4, alpha=6, and a closure-forcing variant. Paired practice evidence for alpha=8: original 32 improved 4->10 correct (7 rescues, 1 loss); three independent validations improved 4->11, 4->7, and MATH/AIME-heavy 2->6. Aggregate independent: 10->24 correct over 96 (18 rescues, 4 losses), and all alpha=8 paired batches: 14->34 over 128 with token-limit failures also reduced (117->94). This supports retaining the edit over restoring base.
